ResMed Digital Health Inc. is hiring an Associate Android Developer to build features for its mobile applications. The role collaborates with cross-functional product and engineering partners to deliver reliable Android experiences and improve application quality, architecture, and performance.
Healthcare
Medical Device
Health Care
Health Diagnostics
Medical
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Develop Android application features using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and modern Android architecture patterns such as MVVM
Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and Mobile Engineering partners to design and deliver new product features
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using established engineering practices
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions
Identify and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and application crashes
Improve application architecture, reliability, and maintainability
Create and maintain unit tests and automated tests that support application quality
Contribute as the Android developer within a cross-functional team, with access to mentorship, pairing, and broader mobile engineering support

Android Development

Required
Experience developing Android applications using modern Android development practices
Proficiency in Kotlin preferred, or experience with Java
Understanding of Android architecture patterns such as MVVM or a similar approach
Knowledge of RESTful APIs and networking
Understanding of concurrency and asynchronous programming, including coroutines and flows
Familiarity with the Android application lifecycle and performance considerations
Familiarity with Git-based version control workflows
Android experience gained through professional work, internships, academic work, or personal projects
A genuine interest in mobile development and a willingness to continue learning
Proactive Mindset: You take initiative, engage early, and look for ways to move work forward
Adaptability: You are comfortable joining a newly formed team and adjusting as priorities and plans take shape
Learning Agility: You seek feedback, explore unfamiliar areas, and actively build your knowledge
Ownership: You follow through on commitments and take responsibility for the quality of your work
Collaborative Approach: You contribute openly, listen to different perspectives, and support shared team outcomes
Growth Orientation: You welcome mentorship while remaining self-directed and resourceful
Preferred
A Bachelor's degree
One to three years of relevant Android development experience
Experience with Jetpack Compose, Android testing, CI/CD pipelines, Agile or Scrum environments, Bluetooth or device integrations, or backend-connected mobile applications
Benefits
Flexible work arrangements
Programs that support personal and professional growth
Medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance
HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and sleep care management
401(k), ESPP, EAP, and tuition assistance
Flex time off for salaried employees
11 paid holidays plus 3 floating holidays
Up to 14 weeks primary caregiver leave or 2 weeks secondary caregiver leave
Structured onboarding
Mentorship tailored to your level of Android knowledge
